mapper.sql: SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, c.teacher_id, c.subject, c.classroom, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.status_code, c.created_at, tu.name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.class_id = c.class_id AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE') AS active_student_count FROM classes c LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id

where.if: AND (c.class_name ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR c.subject ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR tu.name ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classes (class_name, teacher_id, subject, classroom, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{className}, #{teacherId}, #{subject}, #{classroom}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.class_id DESC LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes c LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = t.user_id

SELECT e.enrollment_id, e.enroll_date, e.end_date, e.status_code, s.student_id, s.student_no, s.grade_level, u.name FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY e.status_code, u.name
mapper.update: UPDATE classes SET class_name = #{className}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, subject = #{subject}, classroom = #{classroom}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status_code = #{statusCode} WHERE class_id = #{classId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.class_id DESC LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
